notes: The sources a ledger citation may name, in rank order (BRIEF.md: Book accuracy). Only the published books count. Excluded everywhere: the HBO shows (Game of Thrones, House of the Dragon) and anything derived from them, games, fan art, the unpublished The Winds of Winter preview / sample chapters, and any generated prose. Wikis are finding aids only, never citations. Chapter ids follow each book's own headings: POV name + roman numeral for the novels (e.g. 'Bran I', 'Prologue', 'Epilogue'), the section title for the companion books.

ranks.1: the published novels and novellas: descriptions, heights, distances, relative positions (label T)
ranks.2: The Lands of Ice and Fire: positions of coasts, rivers, roads and castles (label M)
ranks.3: The World of Ice & Fire, Fire & Blood, the novels' endpaper maps: gaps the first two leave (label C; an endpaper map is M)
ranks.4: official illustrations in those books: the look of things the text leaves open, lowest weight (label C)

LOIAF.title: The Lands of Ice and Fire

labels.T: stated in the text (book and chapter)
labels.M: shown on an official map (The Lands of Ice and Fire, or a novel's endpaper map)
labels.C: from a companion book or official art
labels.I: inferred or invented: may never contradict a T or M claim

timeSlice.notes: Physical state is frozen here. Later books may DESCRIBE a place (Moat Cailin in ADWD, Harrenhal in ACOK), and such descriptions count for anything that has not changed since 298 AC; damage done after it (a sack, a burning) is excluded from the build and logged as state-after.
